_section_discord: Entrées ajoutées pour la page « discord » (première passe Claude).
[VCL] - Le bot sur ton serveur Discord: [VCL] - The bot on your Discord server
Le bot des Veilleurs sur ton serveur Dis: The Watchers' bot on your Discord server
Reçois automatiquement, dans ton serveur: Automatically receive, in your server, a card (an image) for every item in the wiki, updated whenever the item changes. You set everything up yourself, in a few minutes.
Tu te connectes avec Discord (le site vo: You log in with Discord (the site only sees your identity and the list of your servers, never your messages), then pick a server where you have the “Manage Server” permission. You invite the bot, choose where and what to send, and confirm. The wiki team then approves the registration (anti-abuse):
rien n'est envoyé avant cette validation: nothing is sent before this approval
voir et écrire dans les salons que tu lu: view and write in the channels you assign to it, create threads/posts, attach images, create the categories and channels of the plan you choose, and — only if you asked for it — hide a channel during a large send (so that everyone isn't notified). It does not read your messages and writes nothing outside the plan's channels.
l'identifiant de ton serveur, son nom, l: your server's ID, its name, the IDs of the chosen channels and roles, your settings, your Discord ID and username (to know who registered the server), and the sending status. Nothing else.
bouton « Désinstaller » sur la page de s: use the “Uninstall” button on the status page. You can also tick “delete the channels created by the bot” and “delete its posts”; the bot then leaves the server and your settings are erased. You can also simply kick it from Discord.
✅ Vérification terminée : les compteurs: ✅ Verification complete: the post counters are up to date.
Tu agis à la place du chef de serveur :: You are acting on behalf of the server owner: everything you do is logged as “Moderation” in the history

Le bot a besoin de : voir et écrire dans: The bot needs to: view and write in channels, create threads, attach files, manage channels (to create those in your plan) and manage roles (to hide a channel during a large send). You can then remove permissions from it in your server settings.
La détection est automatique dès que le: Detection is automatic as soon as the bot is on the server.
